reason: After observing the complete previously unsealed A lambda curves, examine whether logged total pre-clipping gradient norms differ with lambda. This is a descriptive optimization diagnostic, not a new confirmatory mechanism test.

source_semantics.logged_grad_norm: Return value of clip_grad_norm_, total norm before clipping; confirm from captured installed source.
source_semantics.primary_diagnostic: Fraction of train steps where logged grad_norm is strictly above the configured max_grad_norm. Call it threshold-exceedance fraction; do not claim exact floating-point clip activation at the epsilon boundary.
source_semantics.threshold: Read actual per-run config.max_grad_norm, expected1.0; fail on unexplained differences.

aggregation: Individual run values and method/lambda mean plus sample SD over the same3pipeline seeds; correlated steps are not independent experimental samples. Report every declared cell, including null/contradictory patterns.
exclusions: No C or behavior score access
No bootstrap/p values or causal gradient-direction claim
No inference of Adam update magnitudes from total gradient norm alone
No added physical training cost for reused existing logs
timing: Measure whole analysis subprocess wall/user/sys separately from nested verification/plot regions; snapshot source bytes and preserve immutable new namespace.
